_note: All meta-game numbers (coins, police station, city, daily, missions, spin, chests, boosters, ads). Logic: src/core/economy_math.gd (Economy), city.gd, daily.gd, missions.gd, spin.gd, rewards.gd, save_data.gd; Game wraps them. Design: early game is generous (district 1 pays for everything in it), then prices grow faster than income (~1.9x per district for what unlocks vs ~1.45x income), so coins feel scarcer deeper in and the optional x2 ads matter. Nothing is gated behind ads: every level is winnable without purchases.

price_round._note: Prices built from formulas are rounded to clean numbers: below 100 to 5, below 1000 to 10, below 10000 to 50, else to 100.

level_coins._note: Win coins = finale coins (config/finale.json, incl. evidence room) x mult(L). mult(L) = base + per_level x (L-1), x boss_mult on every boss_every-th level, x replay_mult when the level was already beaten. x2 rewarded ad doubles the final number.

_station_note: Cost of level k = base x growth^(k-1), rounded (price_round). req[k-1] = district that must be liberated before level k can be bought (0 = open from the start). Effects: squad +per starting constables, capacity +per squad cap, coins +per finale coin bonus. v2: the knife and speed rooms moved to the Armory (config/armory.json) and the garage's charges to `powers`.

legacy_station_v3._note: Save migration v3 -> v4 only: the prices of the removed rooms. The coins a player spent on armory (knife) and range (speed) levels become hero-knife track steps worth at least as much (rounded up; anything past a maxed track comes back as coins). Garage level g becomes ceil(g/2) stored shields and floor(g/2) stored bombs.

powers._note: Shield and bomb (src/core/powers_timer.gd): `free` charges of each recharge recharge_s seconds after the first is used (real clock, guarded against moving it back); a rewarded ad refills them at once. Stored charges from daily rewards, spin, chests and missions come on top. Every charge the player has is available in each level; only the ones used are spent.

power._note: Squad Power (lobby top bar, level nodes) = dps x (hero knife dmg x throws/s + starting constables x constable dmg x rate) + cap x squad cap + charge x (shields + bombs) + coin_pct x evidence coin bonus in percent; all from the station's real effects (units.json base numbers). recommended = [[level, power], ...], linear between anchors, fitted with tests/econ_sim.gd to what a player who spends their coins has at that level. More than 15% below it, the current or next node shows a warning tint (never under the first-build pointer); every level is still winnable without upgrades.

city._note: 5 districts x 5 buildings. lv 0 = ruin, 1 = rebuilt, 2-4 = upgrades. cost/time/income are for lv 1; level k costs cost x upgrade_cost_mult[k-1], takes time x upgrade_time_mult[k-1] seconds (capped at max_build_seconds) and earns income x income_mult^(k-1) coins per hour. A district's buildings can be rebuilt once the district is reached; upgrades up to pre_liberation_max_level are open while you fight there, higher ones need it liberated (its boss beaten). Liberating district d pays liberation_bonus[d-1] coins once (not doubled by the x2 ad). Storage holds storage.base_hours of income, +hours_per_level per City Hall level. While a building upgrades it keeps earning at its old level.

welcome_back._note: The welcome-back popup shows when at least min_coins wait in storage and the player was away min_away_seconds.

speedup_ad._note: A rewarded ad cuts a build timer by fraction of what is left, at least min_seconds (never past done).

reward_scaling._note: Coins in daily, mission, spin and chest rewards are multiplied by level_coins mult(L) of the player's current level (no boss or replay factor), so they stay worth having deeper in.

daily._note: 7-day calendar. Claim once per calendar day. Claiming the day after the last claim moves on a day; missing a day starts again at day 1 (the panel shows this honestly). After day 7 the calendar starts over. chest = rolled from chests.

missions._note: 3 missions a day from the pool (distinct stats, only those with min_level <= current level). goal = random in [goal[0], goal[1]] rounded to step, then x (1 + per_level x (L-1)) and rounded to step again. Progress counts from the moment they are rolled. Finishing all 3 opens the bonus chest.

spin._note: Lucky spin: free_per_day free spins + ad_per_day spins after a rewarded ad. Each slice is drawn with angle proportional to its weight, and weight / total is exactly its chance.

stars._note: A star chest opens every chest_every stars (best stars per level, summed).

chests._note: coins = random in range, rounded to 10, x reward scaling. Each booster = random in its range; at least min_boosters in total. cosmetic_chance = chance of one cosmetic the player does not own yet (if they own all, cosmetic_coins instead).

boosters._note: Consumable tokens used before a level. headstart = +troops constables at the start, shield / bomb = +charges power charges. ad_per_level = rewarded ads allowed per booster per level. start = tokens a new (or upgraded) save begins with, so players learn them.
boosters._start: v2: shield and bomb are no longer picked here; they come from `powers` (free + stored). start = head-start tokens a new save begins with.

ads._note: Stub only (no SDK yet). Interstitials: only between levels, from from_level, at most one per every_levels completed levels, at least min_seconds apart, never right after a rewarded ad or a revive offer, always closable.
ads._popup: Stub placeholder popup (blank, countdown, close X). Rewarded pays only when the countdown reaches 0; closing early pays nothing. Interstitial shows the X after its countdown and closes itself interstitial_close_after seconds later.

analytics._note: Local JSON-lines event log (no network). Rotated to events.old.log when it passes max_bytes.
